blocks.raw: # Search/Filter Campaign
blocks.text: Search/Filter Campaign

blocks.raw: You can search for campaigns by name. There are different filters available to fetch campaigns by created duration, status, marketing objective, and the user who created.
blocks.text: You can search for campaigns by name. There are different filters available to fetch campaigns by created duration, status, marketing objective, and the user who created.

blocks.raw: ## Search by campaign name
blocks.text: Search by campaign name

blocks.raw: To search for a specific campaign, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To search for a specific campaign, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. On the Campaigns tab, scroll down to the Campaigns summary table.
2. In **Search Campaigns**, enter the name of the campaign to fetch. You will see campaign suggestions as you type.
blocks.text: On the Campaigns tab, scroll down to the Campaigns summary table.In Search Campaigns, enter the name of the campaign to fetch. You will see campaign suggestions as you type.

blocks.raw: ## Filter Campaigns
blocks.text: Filter Campaigns

blocks.raw: You can filter campaigns by active duration, status, marketing objective, and created user.
blocks.text: You can filter campaigns by active duration, status, marketing objective, and created user.

blocks.raw: ### Filter by campaign duration
blocks.text: Filter by campaign duration

blocks.raw: In the duration box, set the duration using **Start Date** and **End Date**. You will get the list of all campaigns that are/were active during that date range.
blocks.text: In the duration box, set the duration using Start Date and End Date. You will get the list of all campaigns that are/were active during that date range.

blocks.raw: > 📘 It is not necessary to match the start date and end date of a campaign with that of the selected date range. You will see campaigns that were active even for one day in the selected date range.
blocks.text: It is not necessary to match the start date and end date of a campaign with that of the selected date range. You will see campaigns that were active even for one day in the selected date range.

blocks.raw: ### Filter by campaign status
blocks.text: Filter by campaign status

blocks.raw: To see campaigns of a specific status, follow these steps.
blocks.text: To see campaigns of a specific status, follow these steps.

blocks.raw:
1. Click (Advanced options).
2. Select the statuses by which you want to see campaigns - Live, Upcoming, and Lapsed.
3. Click **Apply**.
